entry.title: ANSH&CO Bags 34 Metals at India's Best Design Awards 2026
entry.summary: In an unprecedented sweep at the 11th edition of India's Best Design Awards (IBDA), ANSH&CO was honored with 34 metals across brand identity, packaging architecture, and digital product design.

entry.title: Embassy of Switzerland Unveils the Official '80 Years of Friendship' Identity by ANSH&CO
entry.summary: To commemorate the 80th anniversary of the Treaty of Friendship between Switzerland and India, the Embassy of Switzerland in New Delhi commissioned ANSH&CO to architect the official celebratory visual system.

entry.title: ANSH&CO Named Among India's Best Design Studios to Work For — 4th Consecutive Year
entry.summary: Great design is downstream of great culture. For the fourth year running, ANSH&CO has been recognized by the Design India Collective as one of the country's premier creative workplaces.

entry.title: Website Slow Hai Laale? — High-Speed Next.js Architecture & Conversion Optimization
entry.summary: We engineer high-speed digital performance, lightning-fast Next.js interfaces, and conversion-optimized architectures achieving 99+ PageSpeed scores, near-zero bounce rate, and a 3.4x spike in direct-to-consumer sales.

entry.title: Smart Kaam Yaar — Autonomous AI Agents & Enterprise Workflow Automation

entry.title: Zero To Viral — High-Retention Reels, Motion Graphics & Short-Form Video Production
entry.summary: We transform raw, unedited footage into scroll-stopping cinematic reels with precision pacing, dynamic typography, and sound design—driving 5M+ organic impressions and 4.8x higher average watch time.
